lead: Competitive intelligence signals across the rolling year highlight active EFB, flight planning, and crew system deployments, with vendor-specific customer wins distributed among major aviation technology providers.

insights.title: IFS secures multiple carrier adoptions for EFB platform
insights.finding: IFS captured customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform, including selections by fastjet, TUS Airways, and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC), MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is classified as an LCC, and TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Captured feed visibility reflects public announcements rather than total market share.

insights.title: Aviobook signs long-term EFB agreement with Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Thales subsidiary Aviobook secured a five-year agreement to equip Royal Air Maroc pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a full-service international carrier.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems deploys Lido flight solutions to international carriers
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems announced implementations and customer testimonials for Lido Flight 4D and Lido mPilot with carriers including Kenya Airways and Viva.
insights.aviation_context: Kenya Airways is a full-service carrier.
insights.caveat: Captures rely on vendor marketing channels.

insights.title: Navblue expands Skywise adoption with TransNusa
insights.finding: Navblue and its digital suite expanded their relationship with TransNusa to integrate flight and technical operations using Skywise Core X2 and S.FP+.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa operates regional and low-cost services in Southeast Asia.
insights.caveat: Announcements represent specific module expansions rather than enterprise-wide changes.

insights.title: Jeppesen releases updated FliteDeck Pro and ForeFlight features
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced FliteDeck Pro version 5.3 with Enroute Profile View and added new Airflow capabilities to ForeFlight.
insights.aviation_context: ForeFlight and FliteDeck Pro are widely used commercial and business aviation EFB applications.
insights.caveat: Feature rollouts do not guarantee immediate fleet-wide airline adoption.
